mods.name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.3 Port)
mods.description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. A rework of enchantment progression: you can now enchant your gear using enchanted books placed in nearby chiseled bookshelves using a chiseled enchanting table.

item: Apply dye to restore a static tablecloth.
Ink Stain: Miscopied trace (washes off when cleansed)
Recovers passively via nearby total nearby bookshelves (%s / %s shelf tiers)
⚠ Load %s · Overloaded (risk of tier drop or cross-line miscopy)
✦ Copy Gen %s (>%s): Wear immunity expired — uses normal charges
✦ Overload Wear Waiver: %s%% (%s non-curse enchants on one tome)
✦ Template Book Durability: ∞ Immortal (Infinity — zero wear)
✦ Unbreaking Ward: %s%% chance to waive wear

releases.notes:
### What's New in 1.1.0 (from 1.0.3)
> **Unofficial 26.1.2 community port** of Sacramentix's *Chiseled Enchanting Table* (MIT). **Both client and server must update to `1.1.0`.** Existing `1.0.3` worlds migrate automatically — and if you prefer the classic ruleset, a one-click **`1.0.3 Gameplay Rules`** preset is built right in.
`1.1.0` evolves the Chiseled Enchanting Table from a simple book-unlock list into a full, deterministic **3-tab enchanting workshop** — while keeping every mechanic intuitive in-game via the new illustrated **Chiseled Grimoire**.
- **3-Tab Workshop UI & Table Polish** — Switch seamlessly between **Enchant**, **Cleanse**, and **Tomes** with search/filter bars, persistent chest-like slots, a live bookshelf progress badge, a spinning 3D target-item preview above the table, custom 3D rune/ember particles, and dyeable, water-washable, or `jeb_` rainbow tablecloths.
- **Dual-Role Library & Master Tomes** — **Regular Bookshelves** unlock mid-tier blank enchants, difference-credited `I → MAX` upgrades, and **Treasure Epiphany** (`32+` shelves). **Chiseled Bookshelf** books act as rechargeable **Master Tomes** unlocking `1..k` enchants in `1–3` level Vanilla XP mode (up to **`-40%` XP discount**), with multi-select (`Shift`/`Ctrl`/`Ctrl+A`) batch lock/mend/sanctify controls and **3D Locate Beams** in the **Tomes** tab.
- **Smart Deep Inscription Console** — Early Tier I–II enchants and regular-shelf step-ups remain **instant (`0s`)**. Dense high-tier libraries engage timed **Deep Inscription** with 4 live actions: **XP Sacrifice** (`0%` backlash), **Fuel Boost (`-30s`) / Crystal Instant Finish**, **Rush Gamble**, and **Safe Abort** (`100%` XP, material & charge refund).
- **Disenchant, Book Extraction & Curse Purge (`Cleanse`)** — Wipe all non-curses or step down individual levels **for free** with anti-arbitrage XP refunds (**auto-repairing Mending gear first**), strip a single unwanted enchantment, **extract a single enchantment onto a Book**, or purge single/all Curses using **Cleansing Grit**, **Arcane Synthesis Crystal**, or pure vanilla items.
- **Treasure Epiphany, 6 Item Transformations & QoL** — Roll and freeze rotating **Treasure Epiphany** offers; craft **6 Item Transformations** (`Enchanted Golden Apple`, `Trident`, `Totem of Undying`, `Echo Shard`, `Bottle o' Enchanting`, and `Depleted Tome → Book` with `0 XP` **Arcane Decipher** unlock); cycle flexible material options; stack Enchanted Books up to `64`; and combine gear on anvils without *"Too Expensive!"* prior-work scaling.
- **Built-In Illustrated Guide, 4 Presets & Modpack Support** — Open the 8-chapter **Chiseled Grimoire** directly inside the table UI without dropping items, switch between **4 one-click presets** (`1.0.3 Gameplay Rules`, `Casual`, `Standard`, `Expert`), look up every ritual bidirectionally in **JEI & REI** (preserving open table state on return), unlock **29 advancements**, and play across **11 languages** — all `100%` JSON/tag data-driven with **Fabric API** as the sole required dependency.
📖 *For exact shelf thresholds, formulas, recipes, and datapack schemas, open the in-game **Chiseled Grimoire** or read [`docs/WIKI.md`](https://github.com/q14433686-arch/chiseled-enchanting-table-26.1.2-source/blob/chiseled-enchanting-table-26.1.2-source/docs/WIKI.md).*
---
### 1.1.0 更新公告（1.0.3 → 1.1.0 简体中文摘要）
> 本模组为 Sacramentix 原作 *Chiseled Enchanting Table* 的 **Minecraft 26.1.2 非官方社区移植版**（MIT 协议）。**客户端与服务端需同时升级至 `1.1.0`**；旧存档平滑兼容，偏爱旧版机制的玩家可在配置界面一键切换 **「1.0.3 玩法规则」** 预设。
从 `1.0.3` 到 `1.1.0`，纂刻附魔台由单一的「藏书解锁列表」全面升级为集**定向铭刻、无损退魔剥离、母本批量管理与图解秘典**于一体的完整附魔工坊：
- **三页签工坊界面与视效焕新** — 顶部无缝切换 **「附魔升级 / 去除附魔 / 纂刻的书」** 三大功能页，内置搜索与分类筛选栏、箱子式槽位持久化、实时书架档位进度条、台面 **3D 悬浮目标物品预览**、定制 3D 符文/残页粒子，以及支持混色染色、清水洗净与 `jeb_` 彩虹彩蛋的桌布系统。
- **双轨书库分工与雕纹母本管理** — **普通书架**负责白板中阶直附、仅补差价的 `I → 满级` 升阶与 `32` 架开启 **宝藏顿悟**；**雕纹书架**藏书化为可随书库规模**自动回充**的 **雕纹母本**，解锁 `1–3` 级原版经验量产模式与最高 **`-40%` 经验减免**，并在「纂刻的书」页支持 `Shift`/`Ctrl`/`Ctrl+A` 多选批量加解锁/修补/祝圣与多书 **3D 光束定位**。
